trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Proposition, read in full. All ten trap categories clean: the only prose is the two-sentence lead and the definition bullets; the block-final sentence is a cross-reference to the context remark (documented false-positive class), and the one spaced em-dash pair is a true parenthetical. RIGOR PASS (recomputed at the proton pin q_0 = 1.1099785827513808): b = sqrt(q^4+q^2+1)/(q^2+1) = 0.867584067, hbar_q = (q-1)/q = 0.099081716, u = b*hbar_q^2 = 0.0085172346 (context's 0.00852 correct), b^2 = 0.75270211 (context's 0.7527 correct), Q_A = m_e|q^2-2q-1|(q+1)/(2q^3) = 0.78364583 MeV (AGENTS.md's 0.784 correct). The four printed rungs correctly encode c_2 = -1, c_3 = -2, c_4 = c_3 b^4; the odd-looking 'b^4 cdot b^4' is deliberate (c_4's b^4 times u^4's b^4) and is NOT an error.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: FOUR FINDINGS, all math-adjacent so none fixed inline. (1) THE FIFTH RUNG IS WRONG. The boxed formula's last factor is (1 - (b^2 + 1/2) b^5 hbar_q^10), i.e. c_5 = -(b^2+1/2) = -1.25270211. The context remark states c_5 = c_3^2*3 + b = +12.8675841 twice, and tbl:q-beta-categorical-precision-ladder-table3-data labels the N=5 row with that same form. The two differ in SIGN and by a factor of 10, and the numerics decide it: u^5 = 4.4822186e-11, so the -(b^2+1/2) form contributes -0.0561 ppb and moves table 2's N=4 residual of -0.57 ppb to -0.63 ppb, while the 3c_3^2+b form contributes +0.5768 ppb and moves it to +0.0068 ppb -- which is what table 2 ('~0 ppb, sub-ppt') and table 3 ('+0.04 ppb') both report. Only the large positive coefficient reproduces the published N=5 residual, so the boxed formula here carries the superseded coefficient. Note table 1 records that -(b^2+1/2) was 'previously misattributed as c_4', which is how it survived. (2) THE HEADLINE RESIDUAL MATCHES NO ROW OF ITS OWN TABLE. The block claims '-0.0066 ppm residual against CODATA'; tbl:...-table2-data gives +6.02 ppb (= +0.00602 ppm) at N=3 and -0.57 ppb at N=4. The claim differs in sign from the N=3 row and by ~10 percent in magnitude. (3) UNDEFINED SYMBOL, load-bearing: alpha = (z-1)h/2 uses h, which the block never defines -- it defines hbar_q = (q-1)/q instead. The two readings are not interchangeable: reconstructing table 2's N=1 rung (+73.79 ppm) requires h = q - q^{-1} = 0.2090688 (I get +73.64 ppm), whereas h = hbar_q gives +1254 ppm, off by a factor of 17. State h = q - q^{-1} explicitly. (4) CONVENTION C: z is the Markov parameter, given as 1/(q^{1/2}+q^{-1/2}) = 0.49932033 in the sibling direction-sanity gate -- convention C, excised by the 2026-08-15 R1 ruling in favour of z_D = q^3/(q^2+1) = 0.61268804. The dependence is real (z enters alpha, hence the N=1 rung), and AGENTS.md already scopes this whole ladder as C-frame pending re-derivation (bean qou-cds1); recording it here so the block itself carries the scope.
